mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers labor market stress, leading to reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) or unemployment rate does not cross 4.0% threshold as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in federal funds rates and CPIAUCSL (inflation) signal tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates on equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the proxies do not move in tandem as expected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous high growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) creates market overvaluation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime is not actually late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 5,000 in a month signals labor market strength, prompting wage growth fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) or payroll growth does not exceed threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or GDP growth does not follow the trend.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RSAFS (demand) alongside increasing FEDFUNDS rates signals conflicting policy signals, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both RSAFS and FEDFUNDS rise simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the proxies do not move in tandem as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in supply-side indicators (INDPRO) during a supply shock regime triggers reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) or supply shock conditions are not met.
